up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for all compounds that have been tested against the adenosine A3 receptor in assays where the assay organism is Homo sapiens. Join the necessary tables to link compounds to their structures and to the target via assays. Return the distinct ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON md.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.pref_name = 'Adenosine A3 receptor' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens';
